criteria.observation: Four gold clover leaves and the violet shield with a central pale star remain distinct at 48 px.
Each braided red loop ends at a central knot with two tails; a visible metal eye joins the cord to its amulet.
Closed dark contours surround both amulets; loop interiors retain transparency and no detached decoration remains in the exports.
Upper-left cream accents distinguish gold, silver and violet surfaces; red cords share the same warm light and dark outline.
Each canvas contains one centered charm. The four-leaf silhouette and shield star carry the identity without text or external effects.
Both occupy 220 px vertically, about 86% of the export. Braided red oval loops, compact knots, ink weight and highlight direction match visually.
Full scans of both 256x256 files found zero nontransparent border pixels, minimum 18 px margin, and over 10000 pixels with alpha at least 250.

limits: Visual observations at the stated sizes, not exact per-color flatness or pixel-identical cord geometry. Generated interiors predominantly have alpha 254; preserved rather than forced to 255. No Unity import or runtime verification.
